senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (उ) or (ञ-इ) (अचति) (अंचति अंचते)
1 To go, to go to or towards.
2 To worship.
3 To speak indistinctly. See अञ्च.

n. (-क्षुः)
A bad or contracted eye.
mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्ष)
Eyeless, sightless.
E.
अ priv. or dim, and चक्षुस् the eye.

m. (-क्षुः)
A learned man, a Paṇḍita.
E.
आङ्, चक्ष to speak, उमि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. f. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डी-ण्डं)
Gentle, not passionate.
(-ण्डी)
1 A tractable cow.
2 A mild and gentle woman.
E.
अ neg. and चण्डं passionate.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Steady, not fickle.
E.
अ neg. चपल unsteady.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fixed, immoveable.
m. (-लः)
1 A mountain.
2 A pin or bolt.
f. (-ला)
The earth.
E.
अ not, and चल who goes, from चल and अच् aff.

f. (-ला)
The earth.
E.
अचल a mountain, कील a bolt.

m. (त्विट्)
The Koil or Indian cuckoo.
E.
अचल mountain, and त्विष् light.

m. (-पः)
The king of mountains, the personified Himālaya; also analogous compounds, as अचलेन्द्रः, अचलेश्वरः, &c.
E.
अचल and अधिप king.

m. (-ता)
The name of a Jaina saint, one of the eleven pupils of the last pontiff.
E.
अचल and भ्रातृ brother.

n. (-ल्यं)
Firmness, steadiness, consistency: also अचपलता, &c.
E.
च neg. चापल्य in constancy.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Saying, declaring.
E.
आङ् before चक्ष to speak, शानच् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Clumsiness, stupidity.
E.
अचतुर and यञ aff.

m. (-मः)
Rincing the mouth: see the next.

m. (-मः)
Sipping water, rincing the mouth.
E.
आङ्, चम to eat, affix घज्.

n. (-नं)
1 Rincing the mouth, sipping water before religious ceremonies, meals, &c. from the palm of the hand, and spitting it out again; the ceremony also includes touching the body in various parts.
2 Gargling the throat, &c.
E.
आङ् before चमु to eat, युच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A spitting pot.
E.
आचमन, वुन् aff.

n. (-यं)
1 Water for rincing the mouth.
2 A gargle.
E.
आङ् before चम to eat, affix अनीयर.

ind.
Having rinced the mouth, having sipped and ejected a little water.
E.
आङ् before चम to eat, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-म्यं)
1 Rincing the mouth, &c.
2 Water so used.
3 A gargle.
E.
आङ् before चम to eat, ण्यत् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Following, observing, usage, practice.
2 An instituted rite or rule of conduct.
E.
आङ् before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Right, proper, what is to be followed or observed.
E.
आङ् before चर to go, अनीयर aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रन्)
Following, practising, observing.
E.
आङ् before चर to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Observed, practised, either as a rite or usuage.
2 Usual, customary.
2 Enjoined, fixed by rule.
E.
आङ् before चर to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To be gone to or approached.
E.
आङ् before चर to go, यत् aff.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A spiritual guide or teacher; he who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vedas, the law of sacrifice, and religious mysteries.
2 A name of DROṆA, the teacher of the Pāṇḍus.
f. (-र्य्या)
A spiritual [] preceptress.
f. (-र्य्यानी)
The wife of an Ācārya or holy teacher.
E.
आङ्, चर to go, ण्यत् affix, in the fem. टाप् or ङीप् with आनुक inserted.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Sipped and ejected, (as water.)
2 One who has rinced his mouth, &c.
E.
आङ् before चम to eat, affix क्त.

m. (-रः)
1 An established rule of conduct, an ordinance, an institute, a precept.
2 Custom, practice, usage.
E.
आङ्, चर to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Irregular, out of rule.
2 Outcaste.
E.
आचार an institute, and बर्ज्जित abandoned.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Outcaste, void of decent or established practices.
E.
आचार and हीन deprived of.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Conformable to rule or practice.
2 Prescriptive, authorised.
E.
आचार and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Following established rites or practice.
E.
आचार and इनि aff.

n. (-त्वं)
The office or proficiency of a holy teacher.
E.
आचार्य्य and त्व affix; also with तल्, आचार्य्यता.

mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं)
Venerable, honourable.

n. (-नं)
Waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor.
E.
आचार्य्य and उपासना worship.
